item.title: HashKey receives JPMorgan approval to open client money account
item.summary: HashKey Exchange said it received approval to open client money accounts with JPMorgan, weeks after it launched customer fund accounts with DBS Bank. Hong Kong-licensed cryptocurrency exchange HashKey Exchange received approval from JPMorgan Chase to open a client money account, its parent company said Monday. The account will support client fund segregation and settlement through JPMorgan’s banking infrastructure, HashKey Holdings said in a press release. A week earlier, HashKey Holdings combined the previously separate HashKey Exchange and HashKey Global applications into a single portal . Read more
